title: Fast-rising Duo, The impulsive poets dropped their recent single titled "Blindfold"
htmlContent:
The talented duo, the impulsive poets, have once again taken over the music scene with the release of their recent track "BlindFold." The Impulsive Poets comprising Raju Koushik and Rani Salomi, is a fast-rising duo that has climbed the steepest of steps to get to where they are today.

The Impulsive Poets' recent release "Blindfold" captures the complex nature of love. With a fantastic tune that makes the world brighter from the shine of the music, the lyrics remind you that no matter what, love is always present in our lives, and we should embrace it.
